trap.label: sem fonte
trap.wrong: It is estimate that one in six lacks access.
trap.right: It is estimated that one in six lacks access.
trap.why: Em português “estima-se” é reflexivo. Em inglês, passiva com is + particípio estimated.

mcq.q: It is ___ that one in six lacks access.
___ been collected over three years, the data are reliable.

fix.wrong: It is estimate that four in ten lack access.
fix.right: It is estimated that four in ten lack access.

fix.wrong: Having collected over three years, the data are reliable.
fix.right: Having been collected over three years, the data are reliable.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “Experts estimate that one in six lacks access.”
rewrite.answer: It is estimated that one in six lacks access.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “Researchers collected the data over three years. They are reliable.” (Having been…)
rewrite.answer: Having been collected over three years, the data are reliable.
